name: How long does a typical historic window trim restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical historic window trim restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a historic window trim restoration project varies significantly based on the number of windows, the extent of damage, the complexity of the trim profiles, and weather conditions for exterior work. A project involving extensive custom millwork or multiple windows will naturally take longer than minor repairs. For projects in Star or other service areas, we provide a detailed timeline after our initial assessment, accounting for preparation, fabrication, installation, and finishing, allowing you to plan accordingly and understand the project's progression.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on the number of windows, damage extent, trim complexity, and weather. We provide a detailed timeline after assessment.
